title: FE65 Recognition Rewires the Dynamic Contact Network of the Amyloid Precursor Protein Intracellular Domain.
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子动力学模拟研究无序AICD与FE65的互作，揭示结合通过局部热点和构象系综再分配实现而非完全折叠，直接契合无序蛋白PPI机制建模主题。
abstract: The amyloid precursor protein intracellular domain (AICD) is a short, intrinsically disordered signaling fragment that mediates interactions with adaptor proteins involved in APP trafficking and transcription-associated regulation. Among these partners, FE65 recognizes the conserved YENPTY-containing region of AICD, yet the ensemble-level mechanism underlying this interaction remains unclear. Here, we use molecular dynamics simulations to compare unbound and bound AICD together with YENPTY-motif mutant variants. In the unbound state, AICD samples a heterogeneous conformational ensemble dominated by disordered states while retaining transient local structure and recurrent intramolecular contacts. Upon FE65 binding, AICD does not collapse into a single rigid conformation; instead, its conformational ensemble is redistributed toward interaction-compatible substates. Residue-resolved contact analyses identify localized interaction hotspots within and adjacent to the YENPTY region, including aromatic and polar residues that dominate the bound-state contact network. Mutations within the YENPTY motif alter the balance between compact and extended conformations while preserving the intrinsically disordered character of the peptide. Together, these results support a recognition mechanism in which FE65 binds a partially organized AICD ensemble via localized interaction hotspots and ensemble reweighting, rather than through complete disorder-to-order folding. This work provides a molecular framework for understanding APP intracellular-tail recognition and its regulation by sequence-localized perturbations. More broadly, these findings illustrate how intrinsically disordered motifs can achieve specific molecular recognition through redistribution of dynamic contact networks without undergoing complete disorder-to-order transitions.
abstract_zh: 淀粉样前体蛋白胞内结构域（AICD）是一个短小的、本质无序的信号片段，介导与参与APP运输及转录相关调控的适配蛋白的相互作用。在这些伙伴中，FE65识别AICD中保守的含YENPTY区域，然而这一相互作用背后的整体水平机制仍不清楚。在此，我们使用分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟来比较未结合和结合的AICD以及YENPTY基序突变变体。在未结合状态下，AICD采样一个异质的构象整体，以无序状态为主，同时保留瞬时的局部结构和重复的分子内接触。在与FE65结合后，AICD并未坍缩为单一刚性构象；相反，其构象整体被重新分布，朝向与相互作用兼容的亚状态。残基分辨的接触分析识别出YENPTY区域内及其邻近的局部相互作用热点，包括在结合态接触网络中占主导地位的芳香族和极性残基。YENPTY基序内的突变改变了紧凑与延伸构象之间的平衡，同时保留了肽的本质无序特性。综合这些结果，支持一种识别机制，即FE65通过局部相互作用热点和整体重加权来结合部分组织的AICD整体，而非通过完全的无序到有序折叠。这项工作为理解APP胞内尾部的识别及其通过序列局部扰动的调控提供了分子框架。更广泛地，这些发现阐明了本质无序基序如何通过动态接触网络的重新分布实现特异性分子识别，而无需经历完全的无序到有序转变。
